name: velvet-factory-desk
title: Velvet Factory desk — Agency specialists + live tools
notes: Desk is a curated overlay on The Agency roster. 273 specialists stay installed; only these sit on the studio desk.
HQ does not send Instagram, Gmail, WhatsApp, or DMs. Live send stays on Grok Bot (5 seats).
Do not invent ₪ prices or Insights. Write X ₪ when no verified amount exists.
Do not commit secrets, medical files, or personal Drive folders.
Harness: AGENTS.md + packages/vfharness. Six layers on existing packs. No second runtime. After catalog edits run python3 scripts/check-all.py.
Free Claude Code (vffcc) is a local BYOK map only. It does not cut Cursor Cloud usage. Do not install fcc-server on this agent.

queries.bills: label:חשבונות OR subject:(חשבונית OR Invoice4U OR קבלה)

drive.note: No dedicated Velvet Factory studio folder was found. Search by job name, SKU, or filename the user gives. Do not open personal, medical, or legal folders unless the user names them.

superdesign.useWhen: vfcovers, brief packet, posters, social graphics. Graphics path skips repo init.

treg.useWhen: vfgrowth / vfresearch / vfinsights live web, SEO, social, ads data
treg.rule: Say the catalog price before spending. Never invent Insights.

vfmem.useWhen: Route a job to pack / specialist / tool without dumping the warehouse
vfmem.rule: Query the office graph first. Do not install the CBM binary from this repo.

fcc.useWhen: vffcc local-offload after lead seat. Never install here.
fcc.rule: Does not reduce Cursor Cloud usage. Keys stay in ~/.fcc/. No Discord/Telegram.
